The old development key was absent in this checkout; the script created a new debug key.
This signer differs from 0.2.1-beta (726258b1cefd78057b526cd9dd42dcdd99e8b8e5539c686b3ffa40ff8004c403).
The new APK cannot replace the old signed installation. Original-key signing is required
for an upgrade that preserves data. Do not uninstall the old app to work around this:
uninstallation removes its presets, pending import evidence and app-directory photos.

Implementation:
- Native Wi-Fi / USB connection chooser and wireless preset-import guide.
- Shared Wi-Fi-bound sockets and persistent initiator identity with the album.
- Separate PTP/IP Picture Control mode; default album instances remain read-only.
- Reuse of existing read/import sessions, fresh C1-C9 reads, two empty-target checks,
  a single registration attempt, byte-exact readback, and confirmed CloseSession.
- Source NCP is cloned and converted again in the backend.
- Durable schema-2 journal includes transport and endpoint; unknown outcomes require
  read-only recovery through the recorded route. Old records default to USB.
- No automatic retry, overwrite, deletion, rollback or current-preset selection.

The final build only restored full opacity on the active Cancel button.
Independent UI review found this issue; after recapture it scored the issue resolved
and returned disposition ship for the previously reviewed phone UI scope.

Limits:
- No physical-camera wireless handshake, vendor capability, registration or readback test.
- No Nikon proprietary pairing/authentication implementation.
- No reliable evidence yet that Z6II built-in Wi-Fi exposes SetPicCtrlData (0x90CD).
  The current wireless session must advertise required operations and pass read-only checks.
- USB success feedback does not establish Wi-Fi compatibility.
- No real-camera confirmation/success page, tablet, landscape, TalkBack or full OS matrix review.
- Successful adapted-byte registration does not prove Nikon-native conversion or photo effects.
- No user recipe, private SDK source or concept sample photo was bundled.
